title: Does it need to be bootable
patterns: do i need to boot from it
does it replace my windows installer
do i need to make it bootable
response: No. This is a post-install toolkit: you install Windows normally (your own ISO or media), then plug in the toolkit USB and run the launcher inside Windows. Nothing about your Windows installer or boot setup changes.
followup: Want to know what it does right after a format?

title: Right after a format
patterns: does it help after installing windows
does it work after a format
i just did a clean install
what about right after reinstalling windows
what if i format the pc
response: That is exactly the moment it is built for: brand-new Windows with no drivers and no software. Run the driver panel first to restore connectivity, then start the program queue while you set up the rest of the machine.
followup: Do you want the order of operations we recommend?

title: Remote sessions
patterns: can i use it with teamviewer
response: Yes. If you are connected through AnyDesk or TeamViewer, the launcher and driver panel run the same way. Just remember the drivers are on the USB drive, so either copy the needed driver folder across or run it locally.

title: Using it on many computers
patterns: can i use it on many computers
how many machines can i use it on
can i use it on client pcs
response: Unlimited machines, including your clients' — that is the whole point of a repair-shop tool. There is no per-machine fee and no activation limit. The files stay on your USB drive; you install programs on the machine being serviced.
followup: Would you like the purchase link?

title: Backup before formatting
patterns: can i back up client files
response: The toolkit is about what happens after the format; it does not manage client backups. Keep using your usual backup routine for data before wiping a drive — the utilities in the package are for the setup phase, not for data rescue.
